task: Forklift IQ scissor-lift manufacturing-year reference research
summary: Exact-model plate-reading guidance verified. No serial decoder or production-year anchors authorized by this evidence. All substantive manuals are manufacturer-authored documents on third-party hosts; none should be labeled official-domain hosted.

sources.title: ALMAC BiBi 1090-BL Light Use and Maintenance Manual, edition 00, 15/03/2017
sources.author: ALMAC s.r.l.
sources.provenance: Manufacturer-authored manual on a third-party equipment website, not an Almac domain. PDF cover, edition, model scope, and plate page inspected.

sources.title: MANITOU 100 SC-2 / 120 SC-2 / 140 SC Norwegian operator manual, 647367 NO (24/07/2012)
sources.author: MANITOU BF
sources.provenance: Manufacturer-authored manual mirrored by Norwegian rental company Naboen. Not an official Manitou-hosted download. Plate and location illustrations visually checked.

sources.title: MANITOU SE 0808 S1 / SE 1008 S1 EU operator manual, 52779009EN-USM1 (D-01/2024)
sources.author: MANITOU Group
sources.provenance: Manufacturer-authored manual linked as Manual from Key-Tec equipment-sales page; third-party host, not an official Manitou domain. Cover and page 40 verified in downloaded PDF.

sources.title: ALMAC BIBI 1490-BL / BIBI 46-BL / ATHENA 1490-BL Use and Maintenance, Dutch translation, edition 09/2025
sources.author: ALMAC S.p.A.
sources.provenance: Almac-branded manufacturer manual with Duma Rent header/watermark; Dutch translation of original instructions. Third-party rental-company host, not Almac domain. Cover and page 13 inspected.

records.region: CE / European specification in English translation; no blanket worldwide applicability claimed
records.serial_scope: No serial range specified in inspected identification section. Applies only to matching manual/version; no serial encoding verified.

page_cites.purpose: plate year field and base location illustration

verified_findings: Identification plate contains separate model, manufacturing-year and serial-number fields.
Use the machine-specific year field; the manual illustration is not dated production evidence.

A lower-base identification/serial label location is illustrated, near a chassis corner and lifting eye. Do not assert that the full data plate necessarily occupies this illustrated serial-label position.
records.confidence: high for field existence; no decoder confidence
unresolved: No serial-to-year algorithm or annual serial breakpoints found.
Exact plate locations and fields on EVO, ELC, HE and other BIBI variants require matching documentation.

records.serial_scope: No numeric serial range established; restrict to exact models/configurations covered by 647367 NO (24/07/2012).

page_cites.purpose: year fields, plate location, separate engine identification

verified_findings: Manufacturer plate is inside the engine compartment, left of the oil filter.
Figure A has distinct manufacturing-year and model-year boxes, despite the adjacent text listing only manufacturing year.
Engine number/model is identified separately in figure C; it is not the machine serial/year.
records.component_date_warning: Do not substitute engine identification or engine build date for platform manufacture year.
records.confidence: high; plate and location image inspected
unresolved: No serial decoding rule or serial-year breakpoints verified.
Do not apply to unsuffixed SC models or new SE machines without matching documentation.

records.region: EUROPEAN UNION, explicitly on manual cover; EN-USM1 is a document language/code and does not make this a North American manual
records.serial_scope: No numeric serial range established. Series S1 only within the EU manual scope.

page_cites.purpose: separate year fields and illustrated location

verified_findings: Manufacturer plate explicitly distinguishes manufacture year from model year.
Figure 39 locates plate low on the chassis end panel beside/below ground-level controls; describe the pictured panel rather than guessing front/rear orientation.
Serial number is a separate identifier, with no decoding instructions on this page.
records.component_date_warning: Battery, motor, controller and document dates are not machine manufacture dates.
records.confidence: high; cover and plate page visually inspected
unresolved: North American SE 1932 / SE 2632 plate practices not verified by this EU manual.
No public serial-to-year decoder or production-year boundaries found.

records.region: Cover identifies BIBI 46-BL as US and ATHENA 1490-BL as AUS-NZL; Dutch translation also covers BIBI 1490-BL.
records.serial_scope: No serial range or decoder established.

page_cites.purpose: identification plate locations and recording model/serial/year

verified_findings: Identification section directs use of plates on the platform and in the component compartment. Separate PRiMO/EVO drawings show the locations.
The record area asks for model, serial number and year. Plate examples are illustrative and excluded from serial-year anchor data.
records.manufacturing_year_source: Needs legible machine plate; this source supports location and a year field, not a serial-derived year
records.component_date_warning: Do not convert manual edition or battery labels into machine manufacture year.
records.confidence: high for locations/model scope; year-field semantics limited to readable section text
unresolved: Exact multilingual year label on small plate inset not transcribed as verified.
Model-year distinction not established from the inspected section.

excluded_or_unresolved.reason: Search-index text found plate example and 2016 manual revisions, but full retrieval failed (403). Not promoted to verified record or serial-year evidence.

excluded_or_unresolved.item: GTAccess links labeled Almac Operators Manual
excluded_or_unresolved.reason: Links actually returned product datasheets, not operator manuals. Not used for year-identification claims.
Not used as primary manufacturing-year evidence.

excluded_or_unresolved.item: Manual edition dates / source upload directories / illustration years
excluded_or_unresolved.reason: Document or sample dates are not production-year boundaries.

catalog_recommendation: Add records as exact-model plate-reading references, with explicit third-party-host provenance. Leave brand-level serial decoding unresolved; do not fill year ranges from these manuals.
